facts.text: The Independent evidence label denotes a peer-reviewed study, the text of a standard or regulation, official statistics, a third-party test, or a government or agency report; the passage ranks this as the strongest evidence kind.
facts.quote: A peer-reviewed study, the text of a standard or regulation, official statistics, a third-party test, or a government or agency report. The strongest kind.

facts.text: The Vendor evidence label denotes a supplier's own claim, product page, press release or white paper. Vendor evidence is useful but comes from a supplier with something to sell.
facts.quote: A supplier's own claim, product page, press release or white paper. Useful, but the supplier has something to sell.

facts.text: The Expert opinion evidence label denotes a practitioner, consultant or industry-group view without supporting data; such a view is not yet proven.
facts.quote: A practitioner, consultant or industry-group view without data behind it. Worth hearing, not yet proven.

facts.text: The on-road evidence label means evidence proven only for cars, trucks or buses on roads.
facts.quote: Proven only for cars, trucks or buses on roads.

facts.text: Whether on-road evidence transfers to a loaded haul truck on gravel is a central open question for the collision-mitigation validation program.
facts.quote: Whether it transfers to a loaded haul truck on gravel is one of the central open questions of the whole program.

facts.text: The labels draft, under publication and under revision identify a standard that had not been issued in final form by October 2026, or a standard that is being replaced.
facts.quote: A standard that had not been issued in final form by October 2026, or is being replaced.

facts.text: Standards labeled draft, under publication or under revision should be quoted with care.
facts.quote: **(draft)**, **(under publication)**, **(under revision)** | A standard that had not been issued in final form by October 2026, or is being replaced. Quote it with care.

facts.text: The label “not found” means that a question was searched and nothing public was found.
facts.quote: The question was searched and nothing public was found.

facts.text: A number, price or timeline labeled “not found” cannot be taken from the literature and must come from the manufacturer's own work.
facts.quote: it means the number, price or timeline cannot be taken from the literature and must come from the manufacturer's own work.

facts.text: The thirteen chapters contain 1,437 source entries, comprising 974 Independent, 282 Vendor and 181 Expert opinion entries.
facts.quote: Across the thirteen chapters there are 1,437 source entries: 974 Independent, 282 Vendor and 181 Expert opinion.

facts.text: The comparison-table condition-reproduction code G means good agreement with measurements shown.
facts.quote: **G** means good agreement with measurements shown

facts.text: The comparison-table condition-reproduction code P means partial or limited agreement.
facts.quote: **P** partial or limited agreement

facts.text: The comparison-table condition-reproduction code W means weak, heuristic or modelable in principle but unvalidated.
facts.quote: **W** weak, heuristic or modelable in principle but unvalidated

facts.text: The comparison-table condition-reproduction code NF means no simulation or validation was found.
facts.quote: **NF** no simulation or validation found

facts.text: The comparison-table condition-reproduction code n/a means the condition does not physically affect the sensor.
facts.quote: **n/a** means the condition does not affect that sensor physically.

facts.text: The comparison-table evidence code I means an independent peer-reviewed comparison of simulated and real output.
facts.quote: **I** means an independent peer-reviewed comparison of simulated and real output

facts.text: The comparison-table evidence code I- means independent evidence that is small, qualitative, a preprint or industry-authored.
facts.quote: **I-** independent but small, qualitative, preprint or industry-authored

facts.text: The comparison-table evidence code V means the vendor's own claim.
facts.quote: **V** the vendor's own claim

facts.text: The comparison-table evidence code E means expert inference from related evidence.
facts.quote: **E** expert inference from related evidence.

facts.text: The comparison-table code ON means on-road evidence only.
facts.quote: **ON** means on-road evidence only

facts.text: The comparison-table code OFF means some off-road evidence exists.
facts.quote: **OFF** means some off-road evidence exists.
